result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility and styling issue in the promotional banner where white text has very poor contrast against a light green background.

issues.description: The promotional banner ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') uses white text on a very light mint-green background, resulting in extremely low color contrast that makes the text barely legible.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background color (e.g., to a deep green matching the brand primary color) or change the headline and subtext color to a dark shade (such as dark green or charcoal) to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.
